_source: NOCLIP design doc pp. 31-32 (equipment, suits) and p. 8 (Lab upgrades). use: what the item does when used from a tool slot.

items.name: Headlamp battery
items.note: 10 minutes of light (faster drain on Level 6)

items.name: Flashlight
items.note: A focused beam; the Smiler's problem

items.name: Glow sticks (5)
items.note: 2 minutes of light each (30 s on Level 6); drop to mark a route

items.name: Flare
items.note: 30 s of red light; scares Smilers and Clumps; draws everything else

items.name: Almond water
items.note: +25 sanity, +10 health, and a full stamina refill

items.name: Medkit
items.note: Heals 50; revives in 6 s

items.name: Bandages (3)
items.note: Stops bleeding; fixes sprains

items.name: Splint
items.note: Fixes a break

items.name: Radio
items.note: Talk to the crew at any range on the same level (crackly); shows teammates on the map

items.name: Rope (20 m)
items.note: Climb, descend, haul loot up a shaft, tie to a swimmer

items.name: Crowbar
items.note: Pries doors, crates, vents; a weapon (20, stuns a Hound)

items.name: Cart
items.note: Carries 6 medium or 2 large items; loud on hard floors

items.name: Bureau camera
items.note: Photographs entities (dossier bounties) and documents; the flash scares a Smiler

items.name: Scanner
items.note: A heartbeat monitor: living things within 20 m; reveals Skin-Stealers (no heartbeat)

items.name: Breathing tank
items.note: 3 minutes underwater (Level 7)

items.name: Fuel canister
items.note: Runs a Lab generator for a day

items.name: Noise maker
items.note: A wind-up toy that walks and makes noise for 20 s; Hounds follow it

items.name: Shotgun (Bureau-issue)
items.note: Two shells; stuns any entity for 5 s; loud enough to draw everything; a crew owns at most one

items.name: Exit chalk
items.note: Mark walls; marks persist for the day

items.name: Music box
items.note: Wound and set down: +2 sanity per 10 s within 5 m for a minute

items.name: Grappling hook
items.note: Fire to a ledge 15 m; Level 8's best friend

items.name: Thermal flask
items.note: Halves the stamina drain from heat and cold for 10 minutes

suits.name: Hazmat suit
suits.note: Heat's stamina and sanity drains halved; no Deathmoth poison

suits.name: Hard hat with a stronger lamp
suits.note: The headlamp reaches twice as far

suits.name: Bureau Field Kit
suits.note: A better map that shows exits within 20 m

labUpgrades.name: A second camera bank
labUpgrades.note: More of the level on the monitors

labUpgrades.name: Quick-charge coil
labUpgrades.note: A 20 s charge, but the hum is twice as loud

labUpgrades.name: Cargo link
labUpgrades.note: Send the crate to another online Lab, once an hour

labUpgrades.name: The Siren
labUpgrades.note: Draws every entity in the level to the Lab. A terrible idea.
